name: sni-rst
description: A TLS ClientHello naming the relay's cover host is answered with forged TCP resets toward BOTH ends (and dropped); the connection dies immediately after the ClientHello. The box reassembles a ClientHello that spans TCP segments. Only the family that sends that name is blocked.
analogue: The GFW's classic SNI blocking: 'a forged TCP RST + RST/ACK pair is injected to both endpoints' after the plaintext server_name is read, with TCP-level reassembly. Model: in-path and deterministic — the offending segment never reaches the server and exactly one reset goes each way. The real injector is on-path (the ClientHello arrives and the resets race the ServerHello), sends three per direction, and adds 90-180 s of residual 3-tuple blocking; none of that is modelled.
